results.title: Robert Guidi - Is this what AI-powered L&D looks like?
results.content: - Much of what L&D does today is not learning, it’s knowledge distribution that will be taken over by AI. 1. Prompting Cheatsheet (Concise Guide) Objective Prompting Technique Learn a concept “Explain [topic] as if teaching a beginner, with simple examples.” Deepen understanding “Explain how [topic] connects to [related topic] in three key points.” Practice a skill “Create 5 practice questions on [subject] with answers.” Break down complexity “Provide a step-by-step approach to solve [problem].” Improve output quality “Check for accuracy, clarity, and completeness in your previous answer.” Customize learning “Adapt the explanation for an undergraduate studying computer science.” Conclusion AI has substantial value as a learning companion. Developing strategic prompting skills transforms AI from a simple tool into a sophisticated partner in education, ultimately strengthening comprehension, performance, and lifelong learning autonomy.
